# qr2g.it

> Permanent short links and QR codes for public GitHub repositories. One repository has one canonical link that follows it through renames and transfers.

## Docs

- [Usage guide](https://qr2g.it/guide.md): prefilled design links for chats, the HTTP API for scripts and coding agents, limits and error codes.
- [OpenAPI contract](https://qr2g.it/api/v1/openapi.yaml): machine-readable definition of every /api/v1 operation.
